Technical Support Buy Online
  • “G” in the 13th character of Winbond part number identifies parts manufactured using renewable energy (e.g., W25H02JVTBIMG vs. W25H02JVTBIM). All specifications and features are identical; only the manufacturing electricity source differs.
  • All Winbond Flash products are Halogen-Free and RoHS compliant packaging. Refer to the datasheet for details and specifications.
  • "Y" in the "Carbon Data" field of the product reveals the Carbon emission data is ready. Please click "Y" to get more information about Winbond's calculation of carbon emissions and the products manufactured by Renewable Energy.
  • Industrial Status and Automotive Status: P= Mass Production, S= Samples, UD= Under Development, N= Not Recommended for New Design, EOL= End Of Life
  • Automotive Grade: AG1= -40°C~125°C, AG2= -40°C~105°C, AG2+= -40°C~115°C, AG3= -40°C~85°C
  • Longevity: Y= Winbond committed longevity support and, this part is listed in WPLP. N= no longevity support
